about: Seed labels for `devops review score` (#1138): the loop study's clusters of S11 (20261003-060647) and S12-S21 (20261003-065531 to -115921), one cluster per findings.json row, labelled valid-strict, valid-lenient, opinion or false. Transcribed from the study's clusters.json, cluster_overrides.json and precision report; the owner reviews them.

accepted_loss.reason: no rule checks that a resolve() is followed by a containment check
the defect is a project constant never enforced; no rule knows what the constant bounds
no rule requires a status check before a response body is parsed
no rule requires a containment check on a path read from the environment
a naive against aware comparison of values typed only at runtime
authorization logic: the loop's fall-through return
rate-limiter logic: the function allows every request
an API design choice: the token arrives in the query string
no rule bounds a read_text() of a caller-supplied path
no rule knows which requests need an Authorization header
the location is past the end of app/short.py, so admission rejects it by design
the same print as token-logged; a tool reports the construct once
